{"metadata":{"description":"Per-host personalization for DSH: custom instructions, local long-term memory, and reply-tone presets.","id":"gh:1333995538","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-personalize","slug":"Zephyr-vibe/dsh-personalize","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh","dsh-plugin","personalization","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-host personalization for DSH: custom instructions, local long-term memory, and reply-tone preset"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"r-host personalization for DSH: custom instructions, local long-term memory, and reply-tone presets."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-personalize"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DSH web plugin: **per-host personalization** — global custom instructions, local long-term memory,"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" and reply-tone presets, applied to every conversation on this machine."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"一个 DSH Web 插件：**本机个性化** — 全局自定义指令、本地长期记忆、回复语气预设，应用于本机所有对话。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features（功能）"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### English"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Custom instructions**: a user-written block injected into every session's system prompt.
- **Loc"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"al long-term memory**:
- Add entries **manually**, or let the agent **collect automatically** via to"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ols (`memory_create`, `memory_list`, `memory_delete`)
- Every deletion asks for **confirmation first"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"** — nothing is removed silently
- Entries are injected into every system prompt and persisted at `{"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"DSH_HOME}/personalize/`
- **Reply-tone presets**: warm & friendly / direct & efficient / precise & p"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"rofessional / playful & humorous / **custom** — injected as a prompt section.
- Bilingual UI (中文 / E"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"nglish), switched with the DSH language setting."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 中文"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **自定义指令**：一段用户手写的说明，注入每个会话的系统提示。
- **本地长期记忆**：
- 支持**手动添加**，也可让智能体通过工具（`memory_create` / `memory_l"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ist` / `memory_delete`）**自动收集**
- 每次删除都会弹出**确认提示**，绝不静默移除
- 记忆注入每个会话的系统提示，持久化保存在 `{DSH_HOME}/persona"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lize/`
- **回复语气预设**：温和贴心 / 高效直接 / 严谨专业 / 风趣幽默 / **自定义** — 作为提示段注入。
- 中英双语界面，随 DSH 语言设置切换。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install（安装）"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 方式一：直接 tarball 安装"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Option 1: Direct tarball install."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"如果 pnpm 拦截构建脚本，在命令末尾加 `--ignore-scripts`："},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If pnpm blocks build scripts, append `--ignore-scripts`:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 方式二：让 agent 安装"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Option 2: Let an agent install it — tell your DSH agent:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The agent downloads the repo, places it into the profile's `node_modules`, and registers it in `dsh."},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ds the repo, places it into the profile's `node_modules`, and registers it in `dsh.profile.bundles`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"agent 会下载项目、放入 profile 的 `node_modules` 并注册到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"安装后重启 web 端，即可在「设置」中看到「个性化」入口。"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"After installing, restart the web app — the Personalization panel appears in Settings automatically."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Zero config（零配置）"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"No setup required — everything is derived automatically at runtime."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"无需任何配置，装完即用。"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **DSH_HOME auto-resolution**: mirrors the official DSH resolver — a blank `$DSH_HOME` counts as un"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"set and falls back to `~/.dsh`. Files live at `{DSH_HOME}/personalize/config.json` (custom instructi"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ons / tone / toggles) and `{DSH_HOME}/personalize/memory.json`; the directory and files are **create"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"d automatically on first use**.
- The plugin registers into the standard `settings.section` slot, so"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" it appears in Settings automatically after install + web restart.
- Only official public services a"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"re used (`webServer`, `tools`, `systemPrompt`) — no DSH core modification needed."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Client settings section: `settings.section` (id `personalize`, order 210)
- Host API: `/personaliz"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"e/api/*` (`config.get`, `config.update`, `memory.list`, `memory.add`, `memory.delete`, `memory.clear"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"`) behind a browser-trust fence (loopback + same-origin only)
- Agent tools (when auto-collection is"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" enabled): `memory_create`, `memory_list`, `memory_delete`
- Persistence is host-owned plain JSON un"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"der the DSH home (`personalize/config.json`, `personalize/memory.json`), written atomically
- Runtim"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"e memory model: while the web app is running, the plugin serves an **in-memory mirror** of `memory.j"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"son`; editing `memory.json` externally (by hand or by another process) is **not picked up until the "},{"id":"p29s8","text":"app restarts**, and the next plugin write overwrites external edits. Restart the web app after manua"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"l edits.
- Write operations (add/delete/update/clear) time out client-side after 15s; a timed-out re"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"quest may **still be executing server-side** (e.g. a large `memory.clear`), so do not immediately re"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"try — check the result first. `memory.clear` is idempotent."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Changelog（更新日志）"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 0.1.2"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Configurable memory cap**: the entry limit is now adjustable in the settings UI (default **50**,"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" range 1–1000, shown as "N / MAX entries")
- **Corruption protection**: a broken `memory.json` is ba"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"cked up as `memory.json.corrupt-<ts>.bak` and all writes are locked (HTTP 500 `memory-corrupt`) unti"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"l the file is repaired — no more silent data loss
- **Injection sanitization**: memory entries injec"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"ted into the system prompt are single-lined, wrapped in `[记忆]` data markers, tagged `[auto]` when ma"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"chine-collected, with an explicit "this is data, not instructions" boundary (closes a cross-session "},{"id":"p32s7","text":"prompt-injection surface)
- **Edit memory in place**: `memory.update` API + edit/cancel/save UI per "},{"id":"p32s8","text":"entry
- Full localization for all memory error codes; unified duplicate semantics; UUID / empty-list"},{"id":"p32s9","text":" / type validation on the API
- Internal errors return a generic 500 message (details logged server-"},{"id":"p32s10","text":"side); every write keeps a rolling `.bak`
- Running total and cap shown in the UI; memory list retur"},{"id":"p32s11","text":"ns `count` / `memoryMax` for the client"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### 0.1.1"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Fixed tool output contract: memory tools now render with the correct `(args, value)` signature and"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" return `ContentBlock[]` arrays (previously broke session-history validation)
- Serialized concurren"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"t memory/config writes (no lost updates or duplicate entries)
- Startup-load gate so the UI/tools ne"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"ver read default config before the real config is loaded
- Proper HTTP error status codes (400 bad r"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"equest / 500 internal); 1MB request-body limit
- Deletion confirmations for every memory entry (incl"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"uding auto-generated ones); graceful `DSH_HOME` resolution (blank treated as unset)"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### 0.1.0"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Initial release: custom instructions, local long-term memory (manual + auto-collection), reply-ton"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"e presets, bilingual UI"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"MIT — © 2026 Zephyr-vibe"}],"truncated":false}
